notes.title: 1.0.2 - Small Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everyone,
[/b]

We have released a new update to improve the game's experience and immersion. Minor reported bugs have been fixed, and the AI has been enhanced.

1.0.2 Patch Notes

- Now the flashlight has a greater influence on Willie, so it's better to turn it off if you feel he's nearby.
- When you find the last remaining item, Willie will become even more aggressive.
- other minor bugs fixed

Thank you for your patience. If you encounter any more bugs or have suggestions for new additions to the game, feel free to comment in the community or on any of our social media channels.

notes.title: 1.0.1 - Small Update - Bugs Fixed and Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everyone, [/b]

I would like to thank all of you who played our game, I hope you're having fun. :)

[b]1.0.1 Patch Notes[/b]

- Flashlight bug fixed > Now it’s possible to turn the flashlight on and off without any issues.
- Willie's vision > Now he can no longer see through doors, unless it’s made of glass, of course.
- Hiding > Improved escape system when hiding in closets.
- Key visibility > Increased brightness and highlight of the keys.
- other minor bugs fixed

[i]Thank you for your patience. If you encounter any more bugs or have suggestions for new additions to the game, feel free to comment in the community or on any of our social media channels.[/i]
